title: docs: swap DreamShaper RTX 3060 replica for a cheaper Vast host
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
## What changed

Opportunistic cost optimization, not an incident — instance `49063196` (RTX 3060, Mexico, $0.0756/hr) was healthy and not expiring. A live Vast offer scan found a South Korea host at roughly 36% less.

- Replacement instance `51216212` (RTX 3060, South Korea, reliability 0.9953) rented and set up with the correct image (`nvidia/cuda:12.8.1-cudnn-runtime-ubuntu24.04` — the docs already warn the wrong image silently stalls the container; caught and fixed on the first attempt).
- Came up at **$0.057778/hr all-in**, saving ~$12.80/month on this replica.
- DreamShaper doesn't share one tunnel across replicas the way Z-Image does, so this needed a **new** Cloudflare Tunnel (`dreamshaper-canary-51216212`). Tunnel creation and connector-token retrieval worked with the available Cloudflare API access; the DNS CNAME needed `Zone.DNS:Edit`, which that access doesn't include, so it was added manually via the dashboard.
- Verified: registered as the third `sana` pool member, 11/11 real production requests returned 200, then the old Mexico instance was destroyed.

## Note

A same-day attempt to also find a cheaper Z-Image (RTX 5090) host was abandoned — 4 of 5 candidate offers across Asia stalled mid-setup with dead/unresponsive hosts. Left the current Z-Image production instance as-is rather than risk it.

gist.headline: DreamShaper found a sunnier perch
gist.blurb: The DreamShaper replica packed its tiny GPU suitcase and moved to a more economical Vast host in South Korea. Same RTX 3060, fresh tunnel, eleven polite production requests through the door.
gist.summary: Moved the DreamShaper RTX 3060 replica from Vast instance 49063196 in Mexico ($0.0756/hr) to instance 51216212 in South Korea ($0.057778/hr), documenting its CUDA image, dedicated Cloudflare Tunnel, and successful 11/11 production-request verification.
gist.impact: DreamShaper keeps its third sana pool member serving production traffic while this replica runs at roughly 36% lower hourly infrastructure cost.
